periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation tilted downward at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering effect with the lowest point extending toward the ventral region of the cheek.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Smooth U-shaped curvature along the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad band thickness spanning roughly one-third of the visible torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between ears, roughly equivalent to the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, highly rounded apex contours on both visible ears.
